takeaways.text: iPhone revenue hit a June-quarter record $44.6B, up 13% — nearly half of everything Apple sold.
takeaways.title: iPhone drove a June-quarter record

takeaways.text: Services reached a new all-time high at $27.4B, up 13% — nearly 30% of revenue, and Apple's steadiest growth engine.
takeaways.title: Services set another all-time high

takeaways.text: Revenue grew in every geographic segment, the installed base of active devices hit a new all-time high, and EPS rose 12% to $1.57.
takeaways.title: Growth in every region

verdict: Apple set a June-quarter revenue record — $94.0B, up 10% — with iPhone up 13% to $44.6B and Services at an all-time high of $27.4B.
